title: Capstone: Full-Stack Modeling Mastery
brief: The final exam. This sales model is riddled with flaws spanning every discipline you have practiced — structural, semantic, governance, and quality. Seven issues in all, and every one is fixable with the in-app editors: rename, primary-key and PII toggles, grain, SLA, and quality-rule inputs. Clear them all and ship a model that is structurally sound, semantically governed, contract-backed, and test-enforced.

expected_flaws.hint: STRUCTURAL — every table needs a primary key. Which dimension declares none?
expected_flaws.fix: Select dim_customer.customer_sk and tick 'Primary key' in the column editor.

expected_flaws.hint: SEMANTIC — a fact needs one grain. What does a single row of fact_sales mean?
expected_flaws.fix: Open fact_sales' entity settings and declare a grain, e.g. 'one row per sale line'.

expected_flaws.hint: GOVERNANCE — a DIMENSION should carry its type prefix. One dimension does not.
expected_flaws.fix: Open the 'product' entity settings and rename it 'dim_product' (the FK relationship follows).

expected_flaws.hint: GOVERNANCE — personal data must be declared. One column looks like PII but isn't classified.
GOVERNANCE — a Tier-1 asset must promise freshness. Which critical asset declares no SLA?
expected_flaws.fix: Open fact_sales' entity settings and set a freshness SLA, e.g. '< 1h'.

expected_flaws.hint: QUALITY — a range no value can satisfy. Look at quantity's min vs max.
expected_flaws.fix: In the column editor's Quality rules, set a satisfiable range (e.g. min 1, max 1000).

expected_flaws.hint: QUALITY — a pattern that will not compile crashes the generated test. One regex is missing a closing parenthesis.
expected_flaws.fix: Fix the sku regex so it compiles, e.g. '^[A-Z]{3}[0-9]+$'.

solution_notes: The mastered model fixes all four disciplines at once: STRUCTURAL — mark dim_customer.customer_sk as a primary key; SEMANTIC — declare fact_sales' grain; GOVERNANCE — rename 'product' to 'dim_product' (the fact_sales.product_sk FK follows automatically), classify dim_customer.email as PII, and set fact_sales' freshness SLA; QUALITY — repair quantity's contradictory range and product/sku's uncompilable regex. Every fix uses an in-app editor — the primary-key / PII toggles, the Name / grain / SLA fields, and the Quality-rules inputs. After the fixes, re-validation is completely clean, and the exported dbt project + OpenDataContract carry the grain, tier, SLA, PII classification, and quality assertions.
